artworks.title: Beheading of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, yellow, blue-green, blue, and rose
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene involving a wheel and three figures in historical attire. The image depicts a scene with symbolic elements. The composition includes a central figure in a stooped position, two other figures, and a decorative wheel. The style is reminiscent of European Renaissance or Medieval iconography.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in dark blue, light blue, orange, red, green, yellow, brown, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a person carrying a child on their shoulders. The person is walking with one leg forward and the other bent back, with curly hair and a beard. They wear a brown tunic with red details and hold a stick. The child has short hair, wears a striped outfit, and sits on the person's shoulders with one arm raised. In the background, there is a blue sky, a castle-like structure on a hill, greenery, and a body of water.

artworks.title: Saint Dorothy
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in tan, red lake, yellow, and green
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a child. The woman is in a slightly bent position, leaning toward the child. She has pronounced facial features with large eyes and angular eyebrows. She wears a crown of flowers, a golden halo, and a long, flowing robe. In her right hand, she holds a woven basket of flowers, while her left hand offers green leaves with red flowers to the child. The child is standing, reaching up towards the woman and holding a push toy. The child is nude and also has a halo. The background is plain, with the figures placed on a patch of green grass at the bottom. At the top of the image, there is text that reads "Sancta Doro" in a stylized script surrounded by a simple border.

artworks.title: Saint Clare of Assisi
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in wine red, blue, green, carmine, gray, and gold
artworks.description: The image features a person from the waist up, with an oval-shaped face, arched eyebrows, and lips slightly parted. They have dark hair, possibly covered by a halo-like element. The person is wearing a gray and red long loose-fitting garment with a high neckline. They are holding a green object in their right hand. To the right, there is a dark, silhouette-like shape. The background has a large red border, a blue tint at the top, and a patterned section at the bottom with red and blue abstract flower shapes.

artworks.title: Saint Clare of Assisi
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in pink, green, gray, black,gold, and blue
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing, with their head turned slightly towards the viewer. They have fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark hair mostly hidden under a dark headdress, and are wearing a long robe. The person is holding a golden object and standing among greenery. The background is pinkish-brown with abstract designs and a blue border with swirls.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Erasmus
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in light purple, rose, gray-green, yellow, brown, and gray-blue
artworks.description: This is a painting of a historical judicial scene with an execution taking place. The image depicts a group of figures in medieval attire, gathered around a central figure with a crown, suggesting he is a person of authority, sitting on a throne. Surrounding him are advisors or witnesses, listening intently. Below, a recumbent person bound and in the process of being executed by another figure is portrayed. The architecture and detailing reflect a setting of power and governance, with intricate window designs and pillars. The upper section of the painting displays a divine or religious figure encircled by what appears to be a heavenly aura, observing the proceedings from above. The use of earthy colors and the linear style are characteristic of medieval art. This is in the style of an anonymous medieval manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Saint Stephen
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in orange, green, blue and brown
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing upright with both feet visible, holding a palm branch in one hand and a book over three round objects in the other hand. The facial features are simple, with a neutral expression. The individual has short blond hair with a central part, wearing a long red robe with black trim. A large circular halo is depicted around their head. The background features a natural setting with green trees, shrubs, and stylized rocks and mounds of earth, framed within a red border.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, yellow, green, blue, and tan
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with a figure in a brown robe wearing a halo kneeling in prayer, accompanied by an angelic figure. The background includes a small chapel with a green roof, trees, and flowering plants. The style is reminiscent of Lucas Cranach the Elder.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, yellow, indian red, and blue
artworks.description: This is a painting of an angelic figure and two robed figures in a religious scene. The image depicts a scene where a vibrant, winged angel is suspended in the sky, adorned with colorful wings and a radiant halo around its head. Below, two figures dressed in flowing, white robes are positioned. One kneels while the other appears to reach toward the sky. A church with tall spires is seen in the background, surrounded by lush greenery. The painting has a distinct historical style, possibly linked to early Renaissance or Gothic religious art.

artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, green, vermilion, blue, gray, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a religious setting. The central figure is kneeling with both hands raised, short hair with a fringe, marks on their hands, and a stylized face with wide-open eyes. To the left is a winged figure with a halo, offering something to the central figure. The background is a simple landscape with a green ground and a neutral-colored sky, bordered with a frame.

artworks.title: Saint Francis and Saint Clara
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in rose, red, gray, black, yellow, and gold
artworks.description: The image depicts two standing figures shown half-body from their heads to below their knees. Both figures have halos around their heads. The figure on the left has short hair with a crown-like trim and is standing with his right hand raised, while the figure on the right holds a golden object. Both figures have serene facial expressions and their eyes are closed. The background consists of a gold-bordered, pinkish-red wall and green floor.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown-red, green, and vermilion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing over a creature. The figure is in armor, holding a spear and appears to be in the act of slaying the creature. The creature looks like a dragon, with a scaly body and a tail wrapped around the spear. The composition is framed within a rectangular border. The artwork uses a limited color palette of red, green, and brown. The drawing is stylized with bold outlines and detailed patterns, reminiscent of woodcut illustrations from medieval or early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Saint George
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut
artworks.description: This is a painting of a knight slaying a dragon. The image depicts a knight in armor with a feathered helmet, wielding a lance while riding on a horse. The knight appears to be engaged in slaying a dragon-like creature beneath him, which is winding on the ground. To the left, a figure is shown in a prayerful posture wearing a crown. In the right background, there is a depiction of a castle. Text surrounds the characters, integrating Latin script into the visual narrative. This is in the style of medieval European religious iconography.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory [recto]
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, yellow, cinnamon, lilac, possibly with stencil
artworks.description: The image shows two figures within a religious setting. One figure is a standing man with long hair and a beard, standing behind a barrier. The other figure is kneeling, wearing ornate vestments resembling a papal tiara. Several other figures are partially visible behind them, all wearing long garments. Religious objects such as a chalice and liturgical books are also present on the altar. The background features arches supported by columns. The scene is framed by detailed lines and bordered by Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Saint Francis and Saint Clara
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in brown, rose, green, black, and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures standing side by side. The person on the left has short, curly hair and is framed by a halo, wearing a long robe tied at the waist with a rope. The person on the right also has a halo, a headdress with a veil, and holds an ornate staff. Both figures are in front of a brick wall on a grassy area, under a sky with clouds. A central red floral motif and rays intersect the area between the two figures.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, light blue, green, yellow, gold, and orange
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring a crucifixion and figures in a sacred setting. There is a person in robes kneeling at an altar, appearing to be in prayer, while a figure resembling a bishop stands behind. The altar is decorated with a chalice and a set of bound books. Above the altar, there is a depiction of a crucified figure with a halo. The setting suggests an interior space with arched windows and ornate architecture indicative of a church or chapel. The colors are vivid, with bold blues, reds, and greens contrasting the beige background, creating a focus on divine themes while maintaining a sense of solemnity.

artworks.title: The Mass of Saint Gregory
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in green, red lake, tan, and yellow
artworks.description: This is a painting featuring an angel, a monk, and a figure in a window. The angel is holding a rope connected to the monk who is kneeling at an altar with a chalice. Beside the monk, inside a frame or window, there is a figure with visible wounds on their chest. Below the altar, there are two nude figures in flames. The composition includes strong lines and bold colors like red, green, and yellow. The style is reminiscent of early woodcut prints used in religious texts.

artworks.title: Saint John on the Island of Patmos
artworks.medium: woodcut in brown, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, blue, green, tan, gold, and red-orange
artworks.description: This is a painting of a seated figure with a halo, along with a bird and an ethereal figure in the sky. The seated figure is interacting with an open book or scroll in a landscape setting with greenery and water. Beside them, a bird sits attentively. Above them in the sky, there is a radiant, haloed figure. The painting features vibrant greens, blues, and red colors. This artwork is reminiscent of medieval religious iconography or manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Saint Juliana
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in blue, green, rose, brown, tan, and gold
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure standing over a defeated beast. The scene depicts a robed figure holding a staff standing over a creature in a lush green landscape. The painting employs a medieval style with stylized forms and flat colors, characteristic of illumination or early woodcut prints. The colors used are rich blues, greens, and reds against a pale background. The figure's posture suggests triumph, while the creature appears lifeless or submissive.

artworks.title: Saint John the Baptist and Saint Christopher
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red lake, yellow, green, pink, gray, brown, and tan
artworks.description: The image shows two panels with full-length figures. The left panel features a bearded man with long dark hair, standing upright and pointing with his right hand. He wears a ragged garment with a belt, holds a staff in his left hand, and a lamb rests on a book with a cross. A circular halo is behind his head. In the right panel, another bearded man with long hair wades through water, carrying a staff in his left hand. A child with a circular halo sits on his right shoulder, holding a globus cruciger in his right hand. The man wears a tunic tied with a sash and is barefoot, with his lower legs submerged in water. The background is simplistic, focusing on the figures and their attributes.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in gray, rose, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a side view, facing slightly left. The person has long hair, wears a crown, and has stylized facial features with prominent eyes and a defined jawline. They wear a grey cloak over a red garment, hold a staff in their left hand, and a small dragon-like creature is at their feet. The background is a light, textured surface.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, yellow, rose, orange, and blue
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with long, wavy hair, wearing a multi-layered robe in red and a lighter color. The person is holding a lamb in their left arm and a staff with a cross in their right hand. They have a halo above their head. The background has floral and leafy patterns in various colors, with a neutral inner background and green foreground around the feet.

artworks.title: Saint Margaret
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, blue, yellow, vermilion, and gold
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of a person, featuring their upper body and head. The person is depicted sitting or kneeling, leaning slightly to the side while holding a cross-staff. Their facial features are simple and stylized, with a gentle expression. They have blond hair that is depicted with wavy lines and part of their hair is covered by a round halo-like shape. The individual wears a long pink robe with blue sleeves. At their feet sits a small, spotted cat-like creature. The background includes a simple landscape with a path leading to a small building with a cross on top, and a few stylized trees, all outlined in black. The entire scene is enclosed within a yellow border.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in red, green, blue, brown, gold, and yellow
artworks.description: The image shows a person dressed as an angel, positioned upright. They have blonde hair and serene facial expression, wearing a long red robe with a white hem. The angel has large ornate wings that are green with red borders, holding a balance scale with two pans. One pan contains a figure dressed in white with a red hat, and the other contains a smaller figure in a red and gray outfit. The angel also has a pink halo. The background includes green grass and blue horizontal stripes in the sky.
